texts390.text: One signature routes liquidity across chains. An intent routing protocol for cross-chain l
Choose the outcome and let the network handle execution.
Solvers compete to fill your intent.
The entire route settles or reverts.
Reliable execution from signature to settlement.
One signature expresses your outcome and handles the entire route.
Your intent settles in full or reverts, so funds never get stranded in a partial fill.
Solvers compete on the final amount you receive, with gas and fees included.
Bring intent routing into your app through a small interface for a complex problem.
Send and receive native assets without extra wrappers to hold or unwind.
Follow every intent from signature to settlement with each step accounted for.
One intent layer connects different ecosystems.
Supplied protocol snapshot; live telemetry is not connected.
Add cross-chain routing to your app with a single interface for quotes, signatures and set
Read the integration notes for this SDK preview.
